messages.subject: Error in BamFile
parts:
Hi Yuchao,

I'm getting this error when running the following line:

coverageObj <- getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 20)

Error in BamFile(file, index) : 'file' must be character(1) and not NA


However, it gets the coverage for 28 samples before it prints out the error message. I checked the directory and each .bam file has its corresponding .bai file. Any help or input would be appreciated.

Best,

Tom

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: Error in BamFile
parts:
Hi Tom,

It’s hard for me to tell exactly what’s wrong from this one-line code and its error. Can you try bambedObj$bamdir and see if you have any NAs in this? If not, can you make sure the 28th or 29th directory is referring to an actual bam file in that path?

Cheers,
Yuchao
